title: Genteng Ketiga dari Kiri
subject: a young married couple in Cimahi on a Sunday afternoon swapping cracked roof tiles on their kontrakan, she passes the new genteng up the ladder one by one while he, scared of heights, will only keep climbing if she keeps talking to him
caption: Indonesian romantic dangdut duet, modern pop dangdut with a gentle sway, not koplo. Suling bambu trilling the melody hooks, kendang playing the classic dangdut tak-dut groove, mandolin-style electric guitar tremolo fills, warm string pad, round electric bass. Clean bright studio mix. Male and female duet trading lines with warm cengkok ornaments, clearly sung melody, harmony on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, A minor. Mood of a flirty Sunday chore. No koplo speed-up, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - suling melody, kendang groove]
[Verse 1]
Jangan lepas tangga, Dik
Iya, Mas, aku di sini
Kakiku gemetar sedikit
Lihat genteng, jangan lihat ke bawah
[Pre-Chorus]
Satu lagi, ambil ya
Asal kamu terus bicara
[Chorus]
Genteng ketiga dari kiri
Retak sejak kita pindah ke sini
Kamu di bawah, aku di atas
Hatiku tenang dengar suaramu, Dik
[Verse 2]
Ceritakan waktu kita kenal
Kamu jatuhkan es teh di bajuku
Sekarang kamu jatuhkan paku
Tapi kamu masih tertawa begitu
[Chorus]
Genteng ketiga dari kiri
Sudah baru, sudah kita ganti
Turun pelan, pegang tanganku
Malam nanti atap kita nggak bocor lagi
[Outro - suling and kendang fade]
Pegang tangganya, Dik
Selalu, Mas
